Subject: Spectra Renewal & Expansion - Call Recap (Feb 5)

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap of what we covered and next steps so we're all aligned. Please reply with any edits or additions.

Summary of the call:
- Attendees: Jordan Lee (Spectra), Carlos Mendez (Spectra), Marissa Cole (Redwood), Monica Patel (Redwood), Rishi Malhotra (Redwood SE)
- Current state: Spectra is at 55M tokens/month across two products (Search, Summarize). Peak latency requirements: 150-250ms P95 for Search; Summarize can tolerate 400-600ms.
- Pain points: rising token costs during spike windows (esp. marketing campaigns), occasional tail-latency during batch replays, need for better model-version rollout controls for Summarize.
- Goals for renewal/expansion: 1) Renew base contract for current usage, 2) Add reserved Dedicated capacity for Search spikes (predictable cost and latency), 3) Pilot Private deployment for Summarize (data residency for EU customers).

Recommended upsell path we discussed:
1) Renew current hosted plan for annual term (committed tokens).
2) Add Redwood Dedicated pool for Search (initial 2x reserved GPUs for Q2 burst windows).
3) Run a 6-8 week Private pilot for Summarize (EU region) starting late Q2.

High-level timeline we agreed on:
- Week of Feb 8: Redwood to send updated usage report + draft MAAP (attached).
- Feb 10-12: Procurement & legal review window on Spectra side.
- Feb 15: Proposal with pricing for Dedicated + Private pilot submitted by Redwood.
- Mar 1: Target contract signature to align with Q2 budget.

Open questions / blocking items:
- Spectra to confirm expected Q2 spike profile (dates & magnitude) — Jordan to share internal campaign calendar.
- Procurement to confirm whether they need an SOW or PO-first flow.
- Clarify HIPAA & data residency constraints for the Summarize pilot (if any).

Attachments: Spectra-usage-report-Q1.csv (usage by product), Spectra-Draft-MAAP-v2.pdf (initial security & deployment checklist).

Action items (owners):
- Jordan: Share spike dates + procurement contact (by Feb 9).
- Marissa: Send updated pricing proposal & Dedicated sizing recommendation (by Feb 12).
- Rishi: Prepare technical notes on rollout/fallback and HIPAA support options (by Feb 10).
- Monica: Prep CS plan for onboarding Dedicated and Private pilot (by Feb 12).

Thanks — looking forward to the next steps.

Thanks for the quick responses and for looping Liam in. Quick answers below and attached an updated MAAP that calls out our EU residency controls.

- HIPAA / PHI: For the Private pilot we can run the workload in a customer-dedicated VPC in the EU region with customer-managed keys (KMS) and audit logging. Our MAAP v2 includes encryption at rest/in-transit and the audit log retention options. Rishi, attaching for your review — please confirm the HIPAA checklist items.
- Spike sizing: Rishi will send a Dedicated sizing recommendation for the Mar/Apr campaigns by Feb 10.
